name: Amazon Price Refresh
description: Engine for cache-model sites: re-prices the ASINs buyers land on first (clicked, assistant-fetched, pick ASINs, then the long tail) through the Amazon Creators API getItems call within the site's own budget share, upserts price, availability, title, image and detailPageURL into the site's amazon_item_cache, and after a successful run NULLs every Amazon-sourced column past a purge horizon (24h minus the cron period and a run) so nothing is stored for 24h. A failed, partial or unanswered run never blanks data: the rows a run asked about and could not refresh keep their values while still displayable, and the next run re-asks them. Every value (catalog view, priority groups, consumer, resources, columns, schedule) comes from the site's site.yaml; per-site instances are config-only directories in the site repos.
